**Requires:** Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.251+. **Optional:** JEI or REI (recipe lookup and crafting-grid fill), LambDynamicLights.

One Phantom Charm, seven modes: **Chest** (items), **Tank** (fluids), **Anchor** (a waypoint you teleport to, from any dimension), **Collector** (gathers drops and experience), **Saddle** (fly the chest), **Gateway** (a doorway to your anchor anyone can walk through) and **Bell** (every pet at once). Each beyond the chest unlocks with a vanilla advancement. Storage, tanks and charms from 2.x carry over.

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Sneak + scroll with the Phantom Charm | Switch mode: Chest, Tank, Anchor, Collector, Saddle, Gateway, Bell |
| Right-click Phantom Charm | Summon that pet, or recall it to your side if it's out (5 s cooldown). Anchor: teleport to it; looking at it, swap places |
| Sneak + right-click Phantom Charm | Dismiss that pet (same cooldown) |
| Right-click, Saddle mode | Ride the Phantom Chest: fly where you look (WASD, Space rises, sprint is faster); again or sneak to get off |
| Right-click, Gateway mode | Open a 15 s gateway to your anchored anchor that anyone can walk through (3×3 down to 1×2 to fit; look steeply down or up to lay it flat, to catch a fall or fly into); sneak + right-click closes it |
| Right-click, Bell mode | Summon every unlocked pet; sneak + right-click dismisses every following pet (anchored ones stay) |
| Right-click a pet | Open its panel (tank: a bucket or bottle pours in / fills from the active tank) |
| Sneak + right-click a pet | Toggle stay / follow (anchor and collector: anchored in place; tank, holding a bucket: cycle the active tank) |
| Look at a pet ~½ s (idle) | It comes within reach |

| In the chest | |
|---|---|
| Sort icon: click / right-click or scroll / shift + click | Sort / change mode (Name, Amount, Mod) / reverse order |
| Void grid | Filter: matching items your collector picks up are destroyed instead of stored |

| In the tank | |
|---|---|
| Click a gauge (empty cursor) / with a container | Make it the active tank / pour in (left) or fill (right) |
| Overfill / Drain all checkboxes | Let bucket use on the tank spill into or draw from the next tank (off by default) |

**Recipe:** Phantom Membrane ×3 around an Ender Chest, Soul Campfire below, Gold Block in each corner.
**Unlocks:** Tank: *Local Brewery*. Anchor: *Remote Getaway*. Collector: *You've Got a Friend in Me*. Saddle: *Great View From Up Here*. Gateway: *The End... Again...*. Bell: *Hot Tourist Destinations*.
**Client config** (Mods → Phantom Storage → Config): opacity for all pets or each one, and glow on/off per pet.
